mechanism: Betamethasone may increase fluoroquinolone levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while ciprofloxacin can increase corticosteroid effects; corticosteroids also increase risk of fluoroquinolone-associated tendinopathy.
action: Monitor for signs of tendinopathy, QT prolongation, and corticosteroid toxicity; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged corticosteroid use; ensure adequate hydration and avoid excessive physical activity during concurrent use.
